About the Library

A leading public library in Vijayanagara District

City Central Library, Hosapete is one of the leading public libraries in Vijayanagara District. The library provides a good environment for study and a very silent atmosphere for students, researchers, competitive examination aspirants and the general public.

The library holds a rich collection of books, newspapers, magazines, reference materials and digital resources. It serves as an important centre for knowledge, learning and lifelong education in the heart of Hosapete.

Our Building

Near the District Ground

The City Central Library stands in the heart of Hosapete, near the District Ground. Step in to read the day's papers, study in the silent hall, or borrow from the Kannada and English shelves.

It is the main library of the Department of Public Libraries in Vijayanagara District, supported by seven neighbourhood branches across the city.

Become a Member

Membership information

Borrow books from the City Central Library and its branches. Enrol at the membership counter — it only takes a few minutes.

Fees

Membership fee₹200
Application form fee₹2
Total payable₹202

Documents required

  • Membership application form
  • Two passport-size photographs
  • One Xerox copy of Government ID

Where to enrol

At the membership counter of the main library, near the District Ground, Hosapete. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 8 AM – 8 PM.

Part of a State Network

Under the Department of Public Libraries

The City Central Library, Hosapete is part of Karnataka's public library network, headquartered at the historic State Central Library in Bengaluru's Cubbon Park.

Use the official links below for department services, district administration, and the National Library of India.
